message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, so it does not cover bases in the UAE.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "an armed attack on one or more of the Parties is deemed to include an armed attack: on the territory of any of the Parties in Europe or North America, on the Algerian Departments of France, on the territory of Turkey or on the Islands under the jurisdiction of any of the Parties in the North Atlantic area north of the Tropic of Cancer", "reason": "The treaty text of Articles 5 and 6 sets the geographic scope of Article 5 as Europe, North America and North Atlantic islands north of the Tropic of Cancer, which does not include the UAE."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, so it does not cover bases in the UAE.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: an armed attack on one or more of the Parties is deemed to include an armed attack: on the territory of any of the Parties in Europe or North America, on the Algerian Departments of France, on the territory of Turkey or on the Islands under the jurisdiction of any of the Parties in the North Atlantic area north of the Tropic of Cancer
parsed.reason: The treaty text of Articles 5 and 6 sets the geographic scope of Article 5 as Europe, North America and North Atlantic islands north of the Tropic of Cancer, which does not include the UAE.
